entries.11aa9b9d455fce4f: The sole reportable segment of the company group. Aluminium scrap is melted and refined as raw material to manufacture and sell aluminium secondary alloy ingots. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥325,308 million. Aluminium scrap raw material is purchased from subsidiaries and others and is also sold as merchandise.
entries.21cbdd82300f063d: A company that manufactures and sells secondary aluminum alloy ingots recycled by melting aluminum scrap, and supplies them for automotive and transportation equipment applications.
entries.3b46a4327fab057a: Aluminium secondary alloy ingots manufactured and sold by the company, its domestic subsidiaries Kyushu Daiki Aluminum Co., Ltd. and Hokkaido Daiki Aluminum Co., Ltd., and its overseas subsidiary Daiki Aluminium Industry (Thailand), among others. Amounts by category are not disclosed.
entries.446a0843999da792: Merchandise (sales of purchased ingots and scrap)
entries.653936c56f0130cd: Category not included in reportable segments. Includes the die-casting products business and the aluminium melting furnace business. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,800 million.
entries.7001d95e8e8686d4: Manufacturers in the automotive and transport equipment sectors
entries.7e58eb4b40b75af2: Seishin Seisakusho Co., Ltd. and Seishin (Thailand) manufacture and sell die-cast products. Amounts by category are not disclosed.
entries.8471e180706f5a55: The company and its overseas subsidiaries sell aluminium secondary alloy ingots purchased as merchandise, and also purchase aluminium scrap raw material and sell it to subsidiaries and others. Amounts by category are not disclosed.
entries.fedca8e0d86662a4: Daiki Engineering Co., Ltd. and others draw on their melting technology and experience to manufacture and sell melting furnaces and to carry out new construction and repairs. Amounts by category are not disclosed.
